-- Supprimer le pointage de test
DELETE FROM attendances WHERE id = 90004;

-- Vérifier les pointages restants
SELECT id, residentId, packageId, checkInTime, checkOutTime, durationMinutes 
FROM attendances 
WHERE residentId = 1 
ORDER BY createdAt DESC;
